title: Runtime package version reporting
summary: Expose authoritative installed versions from the Agent Plan CLI and Pi adapter.
description: Implement runtime version visibility consistently across every published harness boundary. `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts:1-390` currently treats `--version` and `-v` as unknown positional commands, while `packages/agent-plan/package.json:2-3` contains the authoritative CLI package version. `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:109-151,1157-1159,2474-2488` owns `/planner` completion/help/dispatch but exposes no version action; `packages/pi-adapter/package.json:2-3` contains the installed adapter version. `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts` owns the shared MCP tool surface used by Claude Code and Codex but exposes no `planner-version` tool. `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in` and generated `plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md` own Claude `/planner` routing. Add CLI `-v`/`--version`, Pi `/planner version`, and MCP `planner-version`; route Claude `/planner version` to the MCP tool, while Codex can invoke the same MCP tool directly through natural-language/tool use until its setup gains a slash-command layer. Resolve versions from each installed package manifest rather than hardcoding release numbers, report the actual loaded adapter plus relevant core dependency versions, add package-local/cross-surface tests, update help/docs, and preserve existing command behavior, npm packaging, and harness-agnostic PlanStore semantics.
goals: CLI `agent-plan -v` and `agent-plan --version` report the installed CLI version.
Pi `/planner version` reports the loaded Pi adapter and relevant runtime package versions.
Claude `/planner version` and the shared Claude/Codex MCP tool report the loaded MCP/core versions.
Version values come from installed package manifests and automatically follow package releases.
Focused tests, surface inventory, generated plugin files, and documentation remain synchronized.
nonGoals: Change package release numbering or dist-tag behavior.
Add a Codex-specific slash command mechanism beyond the shared MCP tool.
Couple PlanStore domain behavior to harness package metadata.

acceptedDecisions.title: Version reporting follows the loaded harness package
acceptedDecisions.decision: Expose version reporting at each runtime boundary: `agent-plan -v|--version` for the CLI, `/planner version` for Pi, and `planner-version` for the shared MCP surface used by Claude Code and Codex. Claude's `/planner version` routes to the MCP tool; Codex uses that MCP tool directly until it has a slash-command layer.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Users need to distinguish globally installed CLI, Pi adapter, and MCP package versions because they can update independently and stale runtime processes or package caches otherwise make diagnosis ambiguous.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Read package versions from the installed package manifests adjacent to each runtime module rather than hardcoding constants. Include the relevant loaded dependency versions where useful, keep PlanStore harness-agnostic, synchronize the shared Claude skill template and generated plugin artifact, and cover registrations and output with focused tests.

completionCriteria: Both CLI flags exit successfully and report the installed `agent-plan` version.
Pi `/planner version` reports the installed `@agent-plan/pi-adapter` version.
MCP `planner-version` is registered and returns loaded MCP/core versions in Claude and Codex.
Build, typecheck, focused tests, plugin sync check, and root test suite pass.

tasks.title: Expose installed versions across CLI, Pi, Claude and Codex
tasks.description:
Implement the accepted runtime version-reporting contract. In `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts`, add early `-v`/`--version` handling that reads `packages/agent-plan/package.json` relative to the installed `dist/index.js` and exits successfully without initializing planner state. In `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`, add `/planner version` to completion/help/dispatch and report the installed `@agent-plan/pi-adapter` version plus relevant loaded runtime dependencies using package manifests, without requiring `.planner/`. In `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, register `planner-version` so both Claude Code and Codex receive actual loaded `@agent-plan/mcp` and `@agent-plan/core` versions. Update `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in`, regenerate `plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md`, update CLI/Pi/root documentation, and register any new public surface in `test/surfaces.mjs`. Add tests under `packages/agent-plan/test/`, existing MCP tests, and Pi adapter tests for successful outputs, aliases, registration, and no-plan behavior. Preserve current CLI commands, MCP protocol behavior, Pi planner lifecycle, npm packaging, and release-number ownership; do not hardcode `0.2.21` or a future version.

---
**Completion summary:**
Completed runtime version reporting across CLI, Pi, Claude Code, and Codex MCP. Added `packages/plan-core/src/package-version.ts`; updated `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts`, `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`, and `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`; synchronized `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in` and `plugins/claude-code/skills/planner/SKILL.md`; updated root/package READMEs and `test/surfaces.mjs`; added `packages/agent-plan/test/version.test.mjs` plus MCP/Pi coverage. `agent-plan -v|--version`, Pi `/planner version`, and MCP `planner-version` resolve installed manifests rather than hardcoded release numbers; MCP handshake now advertises the real package version. Validation: `pnpm check`, `pnpm plugins:check`, `pnpm test` (380/380; 82.01% line, 72.18% branch, 76.63% function coverage), `git diff --check`, and npm pack manifest checks all pass. Changes remain uncommitted on `feature/runtime-version-reporting`; resume target is P059(F015)/T253.
tasks.notes: Implemented manifest-derived runtime version reporting across all requested harnesses. Added `packages/plan-core/src/package-version.ts` with `packageVersionFromModule` and `resolvedPackageVersion`; exported it from core. `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts` now supports global `-v`/`--version`, reports the CLI package manifest, documents the flags, and generated Claude setup commands route `version` to `planner-version`. `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts` now advertises the real MCP package version during handshake and registers workspace-independent `planner-version` returning loaded MCP/core versions. `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` now exposes `/planner version` before PlanStore initialization and reports adapter/core/server versions. Updated shared/generated Claude skill, surface inventory, root/package READMEs, and added CLI/MCP/Pi tests. Final validation: `pnpm check`, `pnpm plugins:check`, `pnpm test`, and `git diff --check` pass; root suite 380/380 with 82.01% lines, 72.18% branches, 76.63% functions. npm pack dry-runs confirm package.json is present in agent-plan, plan-mcp, and pi-adapter tarballs.
